name: Bess, Soul Nourisher — each other creature you control with base power and toughness 1/1 gets +X/+X
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (subject probe: 'nobody, amount on the board'). The filter 'with base power and toughness 1/1' had no reading: the 'and' split in _buildAppliesToFromTextInner cut it in two and nothing matched. It is now read ahead of that split (also 'with base power N' and 'with base power or toughness N'); base P/T is recorded on each state as layer 7c begins (engine-layer.js), carried by snapshotState. Bess has two +1/+1 counters, so X = 2. Llanowar Elves (1/1) gets +2/+2; Memnite with a +1/+1 counter is 2/2 but its base is still 1/1, so it gets +2/+2 too; Grizzly Bears (base 2/2) and the opponent's Fugitive Wizard do not; Bess is 'other'. Memory: project_bess_base_pt_and_amount_in_subject_2026-10-14.
